question: What is initiation in its essential nature?
premises: Initiation is directed toward burning away the whole division-made world of transmigration.
Its true function is not merely external ritual.
In reality it consists in true consciousness of that liberating kind.
inference: Initiation is essentially the true consciousness that destroys division-based transmigration.
plain_english: For initiation is vowed to burning away the entire world of transmigration made of division; and in reality it is of the nature of that true consciousness.
